scope: Read-only review of the final SQLite transport and its existing Coordinator/server/observation callers, plus the explicitly authorized installer/environment wiring. Internal shared-context review; not an external independent audit or live account verification.

new_tests_run_by_reviewer.scope: Installer fixture with injected FakeDocker runner; no actual Docker, network, broker or deployment.

findings.origin: Inherited response-validation gap identified while reviewing the port, not a claim that the deadline port introduced it.
findings.mechanism: A response with a pending id but no result, or a null batch result, could previously resolve an awaited save and allow the following broker POST without a valid commit acknowledgement.
findings.remediation: Validate exact id/result or id/error envelope and operation-specific result before removing pending RPC; invalid acknowledgement triggers sticky failure and retains uncertain mutation status.
findings.regression_cases: tools/store30_deadline_test.cjs includes incomplete, null, false, empty-error and contradictory mutation ACKs.

execution_result.scope: 14/14 focused Store tests from implementer; includes five invalid ACK forms and a valid but expired ACK.

findings.mechanism: The bounded transport accepted HARPOON_STORAGE_TIMEOUT_MS directly, but the prior installer whitelist and Compose environment did not pass this key into the container.
findings.remediation: Whitelist the key, validate decimal integer 50..5000 before any command, default to 2000, pass a canonical decimal value to child processes, and explicitly inherit it through Compose.
findings.check_plan_behavior: The real CLI check/plan paths use local files and injected runner; all tested valid and invalid timeout cases execute zero runner commands.
findings.precedence: Explicit process environment overrides the literal env file; absent value uses 2000.

caller_controls.observed_source_behavior: Returns the rejecting write promise to the caller and sets sticky storageError; later saveQueue continuation does not turn the failed caller into success.
Requires nonstopping state, no storageError and acknowledged exclusive account lease. A failed lease rejects authority.
Persists the new client_order_id intent before API POST. A rejected pre-submit save prevents that POST. Uncertain broker result remains UNKNOWN, followed by persistence attempt.
Checks authority and persists cancelAt before DELETE. A rejected pre-cancel save prevents that DELETE. Cancellation request is not interpreted as confirmed cancellation.
Both await authority. Management cannot continue mutating broker state under failed persistent storage; exit protection is therefore not fully available during this failure.

Writes reservation, immutable payload and index in order; local cursor advances only after index ACK. Lost ACK can mean committed SQLite state with stale local memory, requiring reload/reconciliation.
Preserves the larger metadata reservation before awaiting mutable registry write; lost ACK does not release reserved capacity.
Awaits DurableStore.open and Coordinator.initialize before listen/start. Shutdown sets stopping and saves before releasing lease; failure exits unsuccessfully, not as a completed clean checkpoint.
Its existing explicit PAPER route also waits for durable intent before POST. A failed transport rejects this write as well; this does not validate futures economic performance.

transport_contract_observed.failure: Transport error, deadline, backlog or invalid ACK makes the instance FAILED and rejects pending/future RPC.
transport_contract_observed.recovery: No automatic reopen or replay; a new instance and caller reconciliation are required.
transport_contract_observed.uncertainty: Unacknowledged mutation, including lease mutation, may already have committed; uncertainty is retained.
transport_contract_observed.confirmed_error: A well-formed operation error rejects that RPC without inventing uncertain transport loss.
transport_contract_observed.time_basis: performance.now() monotonic; the ACK handler verifies expiration before resolving even if the timer callback has not run yet.
transport_contract_observed.deadline_start: After local JSON serialization, before enqueue/write.
transport_contract_observed.retry: Existing CAS contention retries require an acknowledged false result. Lost/invalid/expired ACKs are not retried.
transport_contract_observed.installer_configuration: HARPOON_STORAGE_TIMEOUT_MS is locally validated and explicitly forwarded by installer and Compose.

existing_caller_regressions.case: an uncertain snapshot write keeps its metadata quota reserved until restart verifies storage

limitations: A rejected save/lease blocks the mutation that depends on it. This is not retrospective revocation of an already acknowledged intent or an in-flight broker request when another operation fails.
Existing broker-accepted protection orders remain external state; their coverage and completion require reconciliation, not assumption.
Full software-managed exit/protection continuity is not promised while durable storage is unavailable.
Health/liveness snapshots can age between asynchronous observations; HTTP_ALIVE is not order authority.
Observed production timing, account recovery and Docker runtime remain unverified.
The timeout is a logical response deadline, not a hard real-time scheduling guarantee while Node or the operating system is blocked. Local JSON serialization precedes that deadline.
Pending RPC count is bounded; byte usage is not newly capped. The 16 MiB compatibility test is not an arbitrary-size memory benchmark.
The inherited 902-test evidence was not rerun by this reviewer. Parent owns the complete final integration suite; targeted reruns are not additional unique tests.

conclusion.operational: A rejected pre-action save or lease prevents the dependent new mutation. The failed Store stays failed and does not silently replay or reopen. A lost mutation ACK requires reconciliation of durable state and external exposure.
conclusion.protection_limit: The existing authority gate also prevents software-managed broker changes while storage is failed. Do not promise complete ongoing position protection during this outage. Already acknowledged intents and in-flight requests are not revoked.
conclusion.installability: The reviewed change is included in the complete 30.12.1 tree and adds no dependency on applying prior patches. Runtime Docker build/start and a real installed account remain unobserved.
conclusion.reason: These are software and fault-handling checks; no new empirical financial observations or live performance measurements were produced.
